-- name: ListExampleNotices :many
-- The example-notice resource owns this file: one query file per table, and every
-- UPDATE below sets updated_at = now().
--
-- Newest first, with an optional case-insensitive name filter. An empty filter
-- matches every row, so one query serves the plain list and the search box
-- instead of two that can drift apart. The id tiebreak makes the order total.
SELECT * FROM example_notices
WHERE (sqlc.arg(query)::text = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || sqlc.arg(query) || '%')
ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
LIMIT sqlc.arg(lim) OFFSET sqlc.arg(off);

-- name: CountExampleNotices :one
SELECT count(*) FROM example_notices
WHERE (sqlc.arg(query)::text = '' OR name ILIKE '%' || sqlc.arg(query) || '%');

-- name: GetExampleNoticeByID :one
SELECT * FROM example_notices WHERE id = sqlc.arg(id);

-- name: CreateExampleNotice :one
INSERT INTO example_notices (name)
VALUES (sqlc.arg(name))
RETURNING *;

-- name: UpdateExampleNotice :one
UPDATE example_notices SET name = sqlc.arg(name), updated_at = now()
WHERE id = sqlc.arg(id)
RETURNING *;

-- name: DeleteExampleNotice :execrows
DELETE FROM example_notices WHERE id = sqlc.arg(id);
